description: Defines a class WorkExperience within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for report display fields related to work experience. The class extends ListableDisplayField and provides methods for retrieving DTO class name, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: Represents a display field for work experience in reports, extending ListableDisplayField, and providing specific configurations for work experience data.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the full class name of the DTO representing work experience data.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity alias used in database queries for work experience.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Specifies the database fields to be retrieved for the work experience display.
